description: This file defines the 'Unit' result class for the Coocook schema, representing units in a database with relationships to projects, conversions, articles, dishes, recipes, and items. It includes methods for finding convertible units and conversions between units.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Unit
classes.description: A class representing the 'units' table in the database, with relationships to projects, conversions, articles, dishes, recipes, and items, and methods for unit conversions.

methods.name: convertible_into
methods.description: Returns all units that the current unit can be converted into via the 'conversions' relationship.

methods.name: find_conversion_into
methods.description: Finds a specific conversion record into another unit by unit ID.
